name: RW03-B5 SAP QA draft operator
description: RW03-B5 (RW03 real-world test). Checks the SAP host and client are QA, signs on with the vault credential, checks each approval signature, finds the vendor and PO, parks a draft invoice only (lines and tax code), reads it back, compares the totals SAP worked out with the invoice, keeps the parked number or cancels the draft on a mismatch, always signs off and proves no posting or payment happened.

variables.name: base
variables.description: Folder of the real-world tests: data, output and the stand-in server.

variables.name: run_id
variables.description: Run id shared by a main agent and its children; made here when empty.

variables.name: standin
variables.description: Address of the local QA stand-in server (127.0.0.1 only).

variables.name: watch
variables.description: Show message boxes and pause between records so a person can follow the run.

variables.name: pause_seconds
variables.description: Pause after each record when watch is on.

variables.name: fault_profile
variables.description: none, or resilience: the stand-ins inject the five failures of runbook step 09.

variables.name: exceptions
variables.description: Records routed to the exception list.

variables.name: status
variables.description: success when every record was handled (routed exceptions included).

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

variables.name: sap_mode
variables.description: simulator (the QA stand-in) or gui (SAP GUI scripting on a machine with SAP Logon and the QA system).

variables.name: sap_client
variables.description: SAP client (mandant); must be a QA client.

variables.name: sap_system
variables.description: SAP Logon entry of the QA system (gui mode).

variables.name: posted_count
variables.description: Posted or paid documents found afterwards (must be 0).

variables.name: evidence_file
variables.description: Evidence rows of this agent (one per record).

args.text: What this agent does: Checks the SAP host and client are QA, signs on with the vault credential, checks each approval signature, finds the vendor and PO, parks a draft invoice only (lines and tax code), reads it back, compares the totals SAP worked out with the invoice, keeps the parked number or cancels the draft on a mismatch, always signs off and proves no posting or payment happened. It works through 10 approved dossiers (the approved ones) and writes its results to the run's output folder.
